storyboard.claim: Denver sees a painted kneeling boy on a shelf in Lady Jones's house.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver in a room, studying a kneeling figure on a shelf.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Denver has walked into town; now she is inside the world that wants her.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the posture of the statue, which is the image the narrator is critiquing.
storyboard.staging: Denver looks at the object and thinks.

storyboard.claim: The statue's inscription is a servile phrase the narrator is attacking.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver pointing at the inscribed statue.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the statue itself to the words painted on its base.
storyboard.addedInformation: The callout quotes the inscription so the viewer reads the phrase as the critique.
storyboard.staging: Denver points at the statue with disgust.

storyboard.claim: Black bodies are still treated as property even in a free state.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver calculating, weighing the danger of returning to the world.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the statue: the same treatment continues in freedom.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the economic idea of commodification in two words.
storyboard.staging: Denver thinks through her survival choice.

storyboard.claim: The narrator says the realization is a painful blow.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver sinking under the weight of the realization.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The reflection continues from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the narrator's emotional reaction a visible body.
storyboard.staging: Denver slumps as if struck.

storyboard.claim: The isolated ledger inside 124 is a closed loop that spirals toward death.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow from closed loop to death spiral.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From Denver's reaction to the structural cause of the danger.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the causal chain the narrator describes as a cause and effect.
storyboard.staging: Denver thinks behind the flow.

storyboard.claim: To save her mother, Denver must rejoin the community's economy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver walking out along the street toward town.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the realization to the decision to leave.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the re-entry literal as a walk toward other people.
storyboard.staging: Denver walks toward town.

storyboard.claim: The community leaves food on the stump outside 124 and it works.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A plate of food on the tree stump outside the house.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The walk to town has paid off with community kindness.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the literal food the neighbors left.
storyboard.staging: Denver's genuine relief at the community's kindness.

storyboard.claim: The community is paying money into Sethe's account.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe holding a coin, the account being repaid.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The food gifts become money contributions.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the account Sethe is depending on.
storyboard.staging: Sethe considers the coin in her hand.

storyboard.claim: Thirty neighborhood women arrive at the yard of 124 without weapons.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe at the yard as a wide shot of the arriving group.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The payments lead to the community's direct intervention.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the number of women as text since a crowd shot would repeat one figure.
storyboard.staging: Sethe surprised at the arrival.

storyboard.claim: The women bring their voices, not weapons, building voice upon voice.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver listening, surprised by the sound.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the arrival to what they bring.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the layered voices the narrator describes.
storyboard.staging: Denver hears the sound.

storyboard.claim: The women surround the house and sing the ghost away, paying the past's debt.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe at the house as the singing is described.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues from the voices to the outcome.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the singing as the act that drives the ghost out.
storyboard.staging: Sethe stands in sorrow as the singing continues.

storyboard.claim: The scene is powerful but the community's delay makes the analyst furious.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver pointing accusingly at the community.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the rescue to the critique of the community.
storyboard.addedInformation: Marks the analyst's anger as the reaction to the community.
storyboard.staging: Denver points at the community in confrontation.

storyboard.claim: The community waited 18 years to help and was jealous of Baby Suggs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs slumped in sorrow over the years lost.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the rescue to why it came so late.
storyboard.addedInformation: Puts the number of years into the callout.
storyboard.staging: Baby Suggs slumps with the weight of the delay.

storyboard.claim: Baby Suggs threw a generous feast for the whole town before the crisis.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A feast table with food for the town.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the generosity that made the community jealous.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the food as the literal feast.
storyboard.staging: Baby Suggs celebrating her generosity, genuine warmth.

storyboard.claim: The community resented Baby Suggs' prosperity and generosity.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs thinking over the resentment around her.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the feast to the community's resentment.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the jealousy directly.
storyboard.staging: Baby Suggs thinks about the resentment.

storyboard.claim: The community deliberately stopped warning Baby Suggs about the slave catchers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs with a blank, indifferent face.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From resentment to the withheld warning.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the community's silence as the grapevine.
storyboard.staging: Blank indifference: the warning never came.

storyboard.claim: The community recognized the schoolteacher's hat and let him reach the door of 124.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The schoolteacher walking up to a door.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the silence to the consequence.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the door as the literal end point of his approach.
storyboard.staging: The schoolteacher's sinister charm as he approaches the door.

storyboard.claim: Petty jealousy directly facilitated a child's death.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe slumped in grief in the kitchen.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the withheld warning to its consequence.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the harm plainly without staging it.
storyboard.staging: Sethe's grief, the harm named by the callout only.

storyboard.claim: The community shunned Sethe for 18 years, a major tragedy of the novel.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe alone in the room, sad.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the consequence to the long shunning.
storyboard.addedInformation: Puts the duration into the callout.
storyboard.staging: Sethe's sad face carries the isolation.

storyboard.claim: The community's failure is not one-sided: Sethe's ledger also matters.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe holding a notes ledger.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From blaming the community to examining Sethe's share.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the ledger the literal object being audited.
storyboard.staging: Sethe thinking over the ledger in her hands.

storyboard.claim: Sethe never asked for help and made no gesture toward the community.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe with a blank face, not reaching out.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the ledger to Sethe's own refusal.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the absence of asking as a blank, unreaching figure.
storyboard.staging: Blank face, idle body: no gesture outward.

storyboard.claim: Sethe walked head high with blank eyes and lived as if alone.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe walking alone down the street.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From not asking to how she lived.
storyboard.addedInformation: Adds the blank eyes as indifference.
storyboard.staging: Sethe walks alone with a blank face.

storyboard.claim: Ella says Sethe was too prideful, and the community read her self-sufficiency as rejection.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe thinking over the accusation of pride.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From Sethe's isolation to the community's reading of it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the accusation in the narrator's words.
storyboard.staging: Sethe thinks over the charge.

storyboard.claim: The ledger between 124 and the town was unbalanced for more than jealousy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver thinking with the ledger in hand.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the blame on both sides to the ledger imbalance.
storyboard.addedInformation: States the narrator's correction as the callout.
storyboard.staging: Denver thinks with the ledger.

storyboard.claim: The stubborn debt of pride sits on both sides of the ledger.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe and Denver side by side, both stubborn.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the ledger to its two sides.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the two sides a two-shot of the family.
storyboard.staging: Two faces, both stubborn.

storyboard.claim: Denver walks to Lady Jones's house to ask for a job and food.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Denver walking the road toward town.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the two-sided debt to the first move.
storyboard.addedInformation: The road is literal: the path she walks to ask.
storyboard.staging: Denver walks the road.

storyboard.claim: Denver's request is the first payment on the debt in 18 years and breaks the stalemate.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow from first payment to stalemate broken.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From Denver's walk to the outcome.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the cause and effect the narrator describes.
storyboard.staging: Denver's surprised reaction behind the flow.

storyboard.claim: Trauma cannot be survived in isolation.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe's face in close-up, sad and thoughtful.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the stalemate to the general lesson.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the lesson as a plain negation the narrator states.
storyboard.staging: Close sad face is the claim.

storyboard.claim: The community learned collective power from Baby Suggs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs, warm and present.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the lesson to its source.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names Baby Suggs as the teacher.
storyboard.staging: Genuine warmth from Baby Suggs.

storyboard.claim: The clearing is the central place of the novel.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A wide view of the clearing in the woods.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From Baby Suggs to the place she led.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the place as a set.
storyboard.staging: Baby Suggs in the clearing.

storyboard.claim: The clearing is a wide open place cut into the woods on a hot Saturday.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Trees around an open clearing.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the clearing's name to its setting.
storyboard.addedInformation: Trees show the woods the clearing is cut from.
storyboard.staging: Baby Suggs in the heat of the clearing.

storyboard.claim: Baby Suggs sits on a flat rock with a twisted hip, old and exhausted.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs seated on a flat rock.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the setting to the preacher.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows her physical state through posture, not harm.
storyboard.staging: Seated, sad, exhausted.

storyboard.claim: Baby Suggs calls the people hiding in the trees to come forward.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs pointing toward the trees.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From her seat to her command.
storyboard.addedInformation: Puts her shouted command into the callout.
storyboard.staging: Commanding point toward the hidden people.

storyboard.claim: She calls the men to dance and the women to cry, a reaccounting of the physical self.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs celebrating in the clearing.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the command to what she calls for.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the dancing as the first call.
storyboard.staging: Celebration with genuine warmth.

storyboard.claim: Slavery itemized the black body for labor, breeding, and punishment.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The schoolteacher holding a notebook of itemized traits.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the clearing to the older itemizing it reverses.
storyboard.addedInformation: The notebook is the literal itemized list.
storyboard.staging: Smirking antagonist with the ledger.

storyboard.claim: Baby Suggs takes the same itemized list and reaccounts it for love.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A heart over Baby Suggs' warm face.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the itemized list to its reversal.
storyboard.addedInformation: The heart is literal love, the claim of the beat.
storyboard.staging: Genuine warmth as the list turns to love.

storyboard.claim: In a world where they own nothing, their bodies are the only thing they truly own.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs with a sad face, speaking of ownership.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the reversal to the body as property.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the body as the only owned thing.
storyboard.staging: Sad face for the losses listed.

storyboard.claim: Baby Suggs is specific about the anatomy in her sermon.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs thinking over the anatomy she names.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the body as owned to the detail of her sermon.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the specificity the narrator praises.
storyboard.staging: Thinking, deliberate delivery.

storyboard.claim: Baby Suggs says the oppressors do not love the flesh; the anatomical ledger of grace follows.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs pointing yonder, angry.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From her anatomical detail to the rejection of the oppressors.
storyboard.addedInformation: Strike marks the narrator rejecting the oppressors' love.
storyboard.staging: Angry point toward yonder: the rejection is staged, not the love.

storyboard.claim: Baby Suggs tells the crowd to love their hands, raise them up and kiss them.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Baby Suggs speaking warmly to the crowd.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the rejection to her positive command.
storyboard.addedInformation: Puts her command in the callout.
storyboard.staging: Warm talk as the command is delivered.
